    Arrow occurrences of a finite tau-category #

    The displayed summands of all chosen right-mesh middle terms form a literal finite type of arrow occurrences. Its target fibre at a label is the finite index type of that middle-term decomposition, so occurrence counting gives exactly the finite-tau multiplicity matrix and local density.
